name: resolved-toolchain-check
command: import shutil, subprocess, json; result={}; names=["node", "npm", "npx"]; [(result.update({name:{"path":shutil.which(name),"version":subprocess.run([name,"--version"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip()}})) for name in names]; print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
